admission.justification: The direction weighed own-chat questions and a dashboard waiting mark against the parent chain, and the choice governs every role, operation and launch handover text changed by this leaf and later instruction work.

alternatives.option: A role agent a parent started sends every developer question to its parent; each parent answers what lies within its authority or passes the question up unchanged with its own recommendation apart; the question surfaces once in the top chat with the asker's role, task and agent id; the developer's answer returns down the chain with the receiving agent's id and his quoted words passed unchanged.
alternatives.reason: D64: the developer reads one chat and can answer there, and the chain keeps the asking agent's identity, what it holds back and its recommendation.

alternatives.option: Keep developer questions in each agent's own chat, as the role texts said before this leaf.
alternatives.reason: The developer saw no marker for a waiting chat and could not find the questions among the run's more than a hundred sessions.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The dashboard marks every waiting chat so the developer can find each one, and the developer chooses own-chat questions again.

alternatives.option: Give the dashboard a visible mark for a chat that waits and leave the questions in the agents' own chats.
alternatives.reason: The packet excludes dashboard changes; which leaf takes the waiting-chat mark is one of its open truth gaps.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A dashboard waiting-chat mark lands or the developer asks for one.

consequences: Every role source, the three operations that carry the duty, the handover developerQuestions value and the role_message refusal remedies state the chain rule.
The parentless and dashboard-started behavior, the L72 coordinator text and the R99 direct peer hand-overs are preserved.
The retired own-chat and no-forwarding sentences are registered so they cannot return unnoticed.
context: The role texts told most roles to put developer questions in their own chat. On 2026-10-05 the Reviewer of leaf L41 asked the developer in its own chat for a further review round; on 2026-10-06 two role agents waited for him in their own chats and he answered that he could not see which chat was waiting. D64 directed that a question from a parented role goes up the chain to the chat at the top.
decider: The developer; D64 (2026-10-06), applied by the architect-approved MIK-R93@v1.
